Name: Wild Cat Farm Cave
Author: WickedyWoah
Description:
[size=5][center]Hey, Hi, Howdy, and Hello[/center][/size]
Have you installed a ton of cat mods like I have that have a buncha cats wandering around the valley? I'm looking at you [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7998]Kitty Cats[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10134]Domestic Animals[/url]... 
﻿Now while you don't need those mods for this one we got here, they got me thinking how nice would it be to have a little place set up for the kitties to get out of cold night air or winter weather.

Thankfully Demetrius thought it might be a nice idea too, and with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10506]Farm Cave Framework[/url], which you [u]do[/u]﻿ need for this, we can now have a nice cozy place set up for the wild and stray cats around. And they bring you little thank you gifts too! Now you won't see these kitties, but you may hear their little meows echo through the hidden winding caverns that we just can't see because we sadly aren't cats. 

Wild cats will bring you offerings of fish, fiber, wool, and sometimes an artifact or mineral. Plus the meows make it all worth it.

[b]NOTE:[/b] If you want to use this cave but have already had the scene with Demetrius, there are a couple of ways you can change mid-game. First, Farm Cave Framework that you need for this has a way in its config file located in the mod folder, which needs to be enabled before you launch smapi. (at least that's how I did it) The option says "ResetEvent" and is set to false by default. Set it to true, save the notepad file, launch the farm you want to change the cave and Demetrius should pop up and ask you again. You will lose any items placed in the cave.

We also have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14000]Change Farm Caves[/url] which is its own mod that lets you change cave options whenever, and I'll be downloading that right away because I had no idea it was a thing and now I must have it.
